title: Mycelium Cycle History
description:
Completed-cycle records. Spec: engine/cycle-learning.md#cycle-record-format; written by /mycelium:retrospective; read by /mycelium:framework-health.

WHY THIS SCHEMA EXISTS (added v0.121.0). This canvas had no schema, so validate_canvas.py reported it parse-checked only and nothing could detect a missing field. Measured on the dogfood repo 2026-08-23: gates_fired, regressions and rework are specified on every cycle record and appeared on ZERO of sixteen — including a cycle recorded the same day it closed. The prose instruction to write them cites anti-pattern #9 by number and achieved nothing, because no schema and no check stood behind it.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY *NOT* REQUIRED. gates_fired, regressions and rework are optional here even though they are the fields whose absence prompted this schema. Requiring them would fail every project that has ever recorded a cycle, which is the day-one-wolf failure: a check noisy from the start gets muted, and a muted check looks like coverage. Their absence is reported instead as a WARN-tier coverage finding by check_cycle_recording.py --coverage, which names how many recent cycles omit them and never fails a build.

cycle.description: One completed cycle. additionalProperties stays TRUE: projects add local fields, and a schema that rejected them would punish record-keeping rather than improve it.

completed_at.description: Absent or null while the cycle is in_flight.

terminal_state.description: archived and killed are discards and pair with discard_reason/discard_phase.

cycle_class.description: Only product-leaf feeds confidence calibration. meta-dogfood and observation carry no ICE BY DESIGN — they are excluded from aggregates, not missing from them.

gates_fired.description: Which theory gates fired. Feeds /framework-health Gate effectiveness. An EMPTY LIST is a measurement (no gate fired); an absent field is not.

regressions.description: IN-CYCLE phase regressions only. Post-launch defects belong in rework. Feeds /framework-health Regression rate. Zero recorded is a measurement; absent is not.

rework.description: POST-DELIVERY defects inside the 14-day window. This is NOT a measure of how much of the cycle's own work was caused by earlier incomplete work — that quantity has no field yet.

allOf.description: MECHANIZES AN EXISTING PROSE GATE. /mycelium:retrospective already says a product-leaf cycle must not be written with a zero ICE total, and offers an honest reconstruction (flagged reconstructed_post_hoc) as the remedy. That rule lived only in skill prose and nothing enforced it. It cannot break existing records that honour it, and it fires exactly where calibration would silently ingest a zero.
